llmCloses.thesis: The FUNDING_EXTREME_SHORT entry relied on gold HL funding below -15% as a crowded-short signal. Since entry, funding has rocketed from -33.7% to +0.87%, crossing well above the entry threshold and turning positive. The extreme short positioning that underpinned the thesis has unwound, invalidating the trade rationale.
